focus: Pack Line Install: Ball, Gap, Help
tagline: Force middle. Move on the pass. The paint is ours.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Tuesday's champion asks his Circle Up question. Tonight we put in our new defense: the pack line. Two things changed from September, say them out loud: one pass away we do NOT deny anymore, we sit in the gap. On the ball we force him MIDDLE, never baseline. Two non-negotiables: you move on the flight of the pass, and you talk every possession. Secret word check: anyone who finished Week 1 of the Player Course whispers me the word, every correct one is a Victory Lap point for his team. Split Team 1 / Team 2 and the station groups: Returners and New guys.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup into partner passing and full speed layups, one team per basket. Say the receiver's name on every pass, silent pass is a redo. Last 3 minutes: first team to 10 straight makes from each side runs the Victory Lap. Losers clap them in, then water.

items.title: Syracuse
items.note: FL, HC, BL sequences with SH (shuffle) and BP (back peddle) variations. Run Set 1 and Set 2. Team vs team for points. Partner rule: not done until your partner is done, faster guy runs the last line beside him. Group calls the variation out loud. Winning team runs the Victory Lap.

items.title: Pack Line Teach
items.note: 3 minutes on the board, 5 on the floor. Draw the pack line, 16 feet from the rim, then lay cones on it so they can see it. Three jobs: BALL (shade baseline, force middle), GAP (on the line between your man and the ball, no deny), HELP (feet in the lane, point to ball and man). Walk 5 defenders through it while a coach carries the ball spot to spot. Every defender points at the ball, points at his man, and yells his job. Freeze and ask one guy: what are you and why?

items.title: Shell Drill: Stage 1 to 2
items.note: 5 on 5, coaches fill in on offense. Stage 1, 6 minutes: no dribble, offense holds every catch for a two count, defense jumps to its new spot while the ball is in the air. Coach yells freeze after any pass: every defender on his spot is 1 point for his team, anyone late and the group runs a down and back. Stage 2, 6 minutes: game-speed passing, defense calls Ball and Help on every pass or the rep does not count. Rotate groups every 3 stops.

items.title: Vegas Closeouts
items.note: Defender starts in help with the ball, passes to the wing and closes out: sprint the first two-thirds, short chop steps, get low, two hands up. Then shade him baseline and take one slide so he has to go middle. A coach stands in the gap as the help. Offense gets 2 dribbles. Drive goes baseline and the defense loses the rep. Games to 3, winner runs the Victory Lap.

items.title: Split Stations: Gap and Help / Force Middle
items.note: SPLIT STATIONS. Returners at the main basket: 2v2 Gap and Help. Ball on the wing, one defender on the ball, one in the gap. Wing drives middle, gap man steps in and stops him, then recovers on the kick. Open kick out is 3 for the offense and the defense runs. Games to 5, winners stay on and run the Victory Lap. New guys at the far basket: Force Middle Slides. Zig zag the length of the floor, defender's top foot high so the dribbler turns middle every time, then 5 Vegas closeouts each with a partner shooting. Count clean reps, top score runs the Victory Lap. Horn at 12.

items.title: Game 4v4: Pack Line Rules
items.note: Everyone together, same teams, man only, no zone. Scoring for the defense: a stop is 1, a stop where every defender was heard talking is 2. Scoring for the offense: a basket is 1, any drive that gets baseline is 2 and the defense owes a down and back. Offensive rebound resets the count. I get two freezes per game: everybody stops, one guy tells me his job. Games to 7. Winner of every game runs the Victory Lap, losers clap them in, then check it right back up.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name before every attempt. Round 1 any miss and the whole team runs a down and back together. Round 2 Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally, the day's champion picks Sunday's Circle Up question. Break the huddle at 7:30.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 finishing from the block, winner stays on, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Full Court Layup Competition
extras.note: 2 minutes if we finish early. Drive layups then a 3 pointer, team score. Beat the team record and everyone runs the Victory Lap together.
